name: Titan Centipede

items.name: Impaling Critical
items.text: When a titan centipede scores a critical hit with its mandibles, the target is painfully pierced with barbed spines and bristles, taking 1d6 persistent bleed damage and becoming Off-Guard as long as the bleed damage continues.

items.name: Titan Centipede Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude save

---
Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 poison damage and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 2d8 poison damage, clumsy 2, and Slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d10 poison damage, clumsy 2, and Slowed 2 (1 round)

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Huge or smaller, foot, DC 28 basic Reflex save

---

items.name: Undulate
items.text: The titan centipede Strides up to its Speed or Steps. During this movement, it can pass through spaces as narrow as 10 feet without Squeezing.

text: These colossal, solitary centipedes claim vast hunting grounds.
